items.title: 33.6 Wastewater Treatment (ganday pani ki safai) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 33.6 (PDF 256-258); the RO and ion-exchange drawing and the resin equation are our own additions.

blocks.text: Pollution ki type (qism) aur severity (shiddat), jaise organic matter, chemicals ya pathogens (bimari wale jaraseem), ke hisaab se pani saaf karne ke mukhtalif tareeqe use hote hain. Yeh tareeqe treatment ke teen levels (darjon) par use hote hain: primary treatment (bara kachra aur thos cheezein hatana), secondary treatment (biological, yani jaraseem ki madad se safai) aur tertiary treatment (chemicals se safai). Neeche ke steps (qadmon) mein physical, biological aur chemical technologies di gayi hain jo pani se mukhtalif contaminants (gandagi) hatati hain.
